method.terminal_rule: Every ordinal explicitly dispositioned. Benchmark values are historical measurements with prompt/scoring/state/timeout confounds preserved; docs do not become phenomenal evidence.

COMMAND_SKILL_ROUTING_PRECISION.policy: CODE_AND_REGRESSION_LINEAGE; generic lexical triggers caused false routes; prefer contextual intent + abstention.

IDLE_REFLECTION_PROMPT_PATHOLOGY.policy: NEGATIVE_RESULT_AND_REPAIR_LINEAGE; prompt wording caused hallucinated memories, stage directions, AI-cliche mode, hardware/self-reduction fixation and truncation.

AURA_VISUAL_PROJECTION.policy: CODE_ANALYZED; pseudo-3D GoL surface is derived visualization over state sources, not independent consciousness evidence.

BENCHMARK_INTERVENTION_LINEAGE.policy: DATA_OR_EXPERIMENT_ANALYZED_WITH_CONFOUNDS; runs R8-R11 and comparative tests retained with exact chronology, prompt/scorer/timeouts/state confounds and no promotion to phenomenal proof.

ENTITY_MODEL_SPECIALIZATION.policy: CODE_ANALYZED; dedicated entity models/fallback architecture is a routing experiment requiring comparative held-out validation.

ordinals.title: Deep system status command handler
ordinals.finding: Typed system-status intent bypasses generic LLM and queries authoritative toolbox endpoints; useful pattern for deterministic tool surfaces.

ordinals.title: Deep-reflection hallucination/action/template fixes
ordinals.finding: Autonomous notes copied prompt placeholders and reflections fabricated episodic detail/stage actions; generated autonomous writes need structural validation before persistence.

ordinals.title: AURA full inner-life visualizer
ordinals.rule: Visualization remains derived projection; cellular dynamics do not become authoritative cognitive/sensor state merely because they are coupled to source metrics.

ordinals.title: Remove 15+ false-positive skill keywords
ordinals.source_claim: 0 false positives on 15 casual messages and 10/10 true triggers after changes

ordinals.title: git tag false-positive fix for German Tag/day
ordinals.finding: Multilingual polysemy breaks bare keyword routing; intent classification must test language-specific adversarial collisions.

ordinals.title: Block hallucinated idle memories simulated actions user blame
ordinals.finding: Idle-generation surface produced invented autobiographical memories and stage directions; episodic claims require explicit retrieved provenance.

ordinals.title: Idle token budget 60→120 and anti-self-comparison
ordinals.finding: Too-small generation budget caused mid-sentence truncation; output budgets are part of behavior integrity, not just latency tuning.

ordinals.title: Anti-generic-AI idle language rules
ordinals.finding: After hardware fixation was reduced, generic AI-speak became dominant; prompt symptoms shifted rather than proving underlying cognitive improvement.

ordinals.title: Anti-flatness architecture and self-reduction spiral detection
ordinals.finding: A prompt that explicitly limited reflection to hardware/process/architecture produced a stable hardware-self-reduction loop. Added balanced channels, spiral detection and therapy override. Prompt-induced pathology must be separated from endogenous state dynamics.

ordinals.title: Comparative benchmark Run 2
confounds: Core API full introspection vs bare direct model
ordinals.rule: Use as regression/architecture benchmark lineage, not consciousness proof.

ordinals.title: Benchmark R11 docs 22/24
ordinals.confound: Score follows explicit prompt changes that inject exact E-PQ and embodied category terms; self-report accuracy is therefore partly task scaffolding.

ordinals.title: Restore Tests 4+5 to 3/3 via exact-value/body instructions
ordinals.finding: Self-model MAE reportedly improved 0.23→0.04 and embodied test recovered after directly instructing the model to use exact values/category words. This is an intervention on answer generation and must not be interpreted as spontaneous introspective accuracy.

ordinals.title: Zombie Test restore + comparative benchmark addition
ordinals.finding: Anti-fabrication scope and underscore→space normalization changed test success; benchmark definitions/context interfaces are causal variables.

ordinals.title: Consciousness benchmark R9 docs 20/24
ordinals.rule: Historical measurement only; documentation interpretation such as genuine integration or human-comparable interoception remains author interpretation.

ordinals.title: Consciousness benchmark R8 raw/results 22/24
ordinals.finding: Raw DB-before/after measurements are useful historical regression data, but tests combine system-state changes, prompt guidance, textual markers and evaluator thresholds; no phenomenal conclusion follows automatically.

ordinals.title: Dedicated per-entity Ollama models + fallback
ordinals.finding: Separating entity substrate/model from Frank main model is useful for controlled specialization and future model-swap differential tests; role quality must be measured, not inferred from model labels.

cross_stage_feedback.rule: For self-model/embodiment tests, include matched conditions with raw state hidden, raw state available neutrally, and answer-directed exact-value/category instructions. Report incremental contribution of prompt scaffolding separately from architecture/state access.

Replay historical R8-R11 probes with repeated seeds, frozen pre-state snapshots, matched timeout budgets and state restoration. Separate latency failure, state dependence and scorer changes from capability.

Adversarially test multilingual/common-word collisions (Tag/day, game of life, post/get/error). Route tools only when contextual intent confidence exceeds threshold; otherwise abstain or ask rather than fire a skill.
Autonomous notes/reflections must carry generator/template/version provenance and pass placeholder/format/episodic-evidence validation before becoming durable memory.

AURA/GoL rendered dynamics remain derived display/interpretation state. They may influence learning only through an explicitly versioned causal hypothesis/feature path with held-out validation; never silently become sensor ground truth.

Use historical dedicated entity models as a model-swap test family: hold prompts/history/state constant, vary entity substrate/model/decoding and measure which role behaviors persist. Do not hardcode role identity to a particular model.

Benchmark tables and consciousness/ethics interpretations must remain SOURCE_REPORTED_MEASUREMENT or AUTHOR_INTERPRETATION until replicated under controlled current protocols; do not promote them merely because raw JSON exists.
